summary: Pinned down which target validator produces the request-level ErrInvalidAddress branch in the RequestAddNode contract mismatch. GetTargetValidator returns id.IsNodeHostID in AddressByNodeHostID mode, the transport factory's Validate when one is configured, and stringutil.IsValidAddress otherwise; node.requestConfigChange applies that predicate to every non-remove change before building the ConfigChange. So the documented ignored-target invocation fails at the request layer under the default validator and would instead reach the membership-layer rejection under a permissive custom validator. Added two source ranges, a behavior entry and an explicit knowledge use, and narrowed the first limitation to say the request-level branch is source-traced with only the validator resolution read. The control, conclusion and asserted defect claim are unchanged. Validation reports valid, no_change false, execution_requested false. No execution was run.
